summary: Milestone 2026.09.688 completed 7 compute-bound experiments in 110.0 wall-time minutes (averaging 16 minutes per experiment), reconstructed from disk modification times. 'Fit source energies after primary artifact routing is qualified' was the longest-running task at 38.76 minutes, followed by 'Bind twelve tasks and reuse qualified evidence with current methods' at 16.35 minutes, with intra-task phase breakdown absent from the milestone timing data. The locked GPU-idle indicator is false, while static monitor telemetry recorded 0% utilization across both RTX 3090 GPUs.
bottlenecks_identified: Source energy fitting represents the largest single latency focus at 38.76 minutes (over 35% of total wall time), followed by task binding at 16.35 minutes, independent outcome reduction at 13.82 minutes, live supervisor evidence recovery at 13.3 minutes, and bounded Qwen decisions at 12.87 minutes; intra-task stage breakdowns (model loading, inference, validation) are absent from the timing data.
Milestone timing relied on disk-mtime fallback reconstruction because the live git-log path encountered zero commits, creating an attribution gap for intra-task latency phases.

Continuous execution-window GPU utilization and multi-model concurrency telemetry are absent from milestone data, precluding empirical measurement of accelerator efficiency or multi-model dispatch during active execution.
improvements_suggested: Introduce structured monotonic phase timing receipts (tracking model loading, execution, evaluation, and validation) into the runner to attribute latency within long-running experiments.
Sample continuous GPU utilization, VRAM usage, and active model concurrency throughout task execution windows to correlate compute load with accelerator utilization.
Profile and optimize the source energy fitting workflow (38.76 minutes) and task binding workflow (16.35 minutes), exploring intermediate artifact caching where valid.
Restrict DualGPURunner dispatch strictly to verified concurrent multi-model workloads, ensuring single-model tasks target a single GPU without unneeded orchestration.
Retain the failure_ledger pre-launch doomed-rerun check to preemptively block doomed tasks before wall time is consumed.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Implement granular task phase receipts in the runner to isolate model loading, compute, and validation stages for the slowest workloads.
Record continuous time-series GPU telemetry alongside active model identifiers during compute runs to evaluate accelerator utilization empirically.
Target optimization and checkpoint reuse on the source energy fitting (38.76 min) and task binding (16.35 min) pipelines.
